name: search
description:
Search the files this session can see, by meaning and by words together: the best passages first, each with its path and line range. Use it to find where something is discussed or answered when you do not know the exact words; use grep for exact text or a pattern, glob for file names.

- `path` limits the search to a directory (default: everything this session can see).
- A passage is an extract. Read the file around it before answering from it when the answer turns on detail, and cite the path.
- Only indexed files are searched: text, Markdown, code, JSON and the text of PDF and DOCX files, up to a size limit. A file just written is found once it has been indexed.

query.description: What to look for, in words: a question or the topic

path.description: Directory to search (default: everything this session can see)
